title: MCP server normalization audit package
claim: FP-MCP-351 created a research-backed MCP server normalization audit, tool inventory, risk matrix, refactor plan, and executor recommendation for reducing src/server.ts ambiguity before further operational execution work.
summary: The MCP bridge now contains five audit/planning documents: docs/mcp-server-normalization-audit.md, docs/mcp-tool-risk-matrix.md, docs/mcp-tool-surface-inventory.json, docs/server-ts-refactor-plan.md, and docs/refactor-executor-recommendation.md. The audit measured src/server.ts at 18,640 lines and 68 registered MCP tools, classified the tool surface into ChatGPT-safe, gated-visible, and dev/hidden groups, and recommended behavior-preserving extraction plus contract/surface-profile work before additional runner operations. The bridge docs were committed at 5e08d9d after pnpm test passed.
caveats: The tool classification is an initial static inventory and should be regenerated after tool registration changes.
The audit documents do not change runtime tool behavior.
The bridge branch remains ahead of origin until pushed manually because prior push attempts were blocked by host safety checks.
The recommendation is to use Copilot/Codex/Claude for the first mechanical extraction, not DeepSeek/Qwen through OpenCode until the bridge is normalized.
boundaries: Did not refactor server.ts in this packet.
Did not change any MCP runtime behavior.
Did not clear the disable switch.
